release_safe.description: Sources currently approved by the FlyWireLLM project policy for checkpoints intended to remain eligible for future release, subject to source-specific attribution/notice obligations.

research_only.description: Conditional or unresolved sources allowed only in isolated research checkpoints.

tatoeba-sentences.reason: Dataset sentence exports have an explicit CC BY 2.0 FR reuse path; attribution obligations remain.

mozilla-common-voice.reason: Current project policy accepts CC0 release snapshots subject to release-specific verification.

wikimedia-thwiki.reason: CC BY-SA/GFDL and project/imported-content compliance remain unresolved for production model redistribution.

wikimedia-enwiki.reason: CC BY-SA/GFDL compliance remains unresolved for production model redistribution.

fineweb2-thai.reason: Dataset-level ODC-By does not resolve heterogeneous underlying web-content rights, PII and opt-out policy.

fineweb-english.reason: Dataset-level ODC-By does not resolve heterogeneous underlying web-content rights, PII and opt-out policy.

project-gutenberg.reason: Per-work and jurisdiction-specific rights must be qualified before individual works can move to release_safe.

flywiremodel-curated-export.reason: Automatic export remains blocked until source rights and frozen scientific evaluation controls are separated.
